summary: Verified 3 real client video testimonials on Cherry Tree landing page. All 3 cards render with correct names/companies/locations. Modal opens on each card click, and the correct player mounts (autoPlay=true): Card1 -> Loom iframe with id 586c3a1df10c4ff1b2773b68ccd3c4e9, Card2 -> Vimeo iframe with id 1214123088, Card3 -> HTML5 <video> with src /testimonials/prime-baths.mp4. MP4 asset returns HTTP 200 with content-type video/mp4 at the public backend URL. Only 3 testimonial cards exist (as intended).
critical_code_review_comments: Radix Dialog Escape-to-close does not work while a Loom/Vimeo iframe holds focus (iframe swallows keydown so document-level Escape listener never fires). Clicking outside the modal still closes it correctly. Consider adding an explicit visible close button inside DialogContent (Radix DialogClose) so users on an autoplaying iframe can dismiss reliably via keyboard/click without needing to click the overlay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonial modal is a Radix Dialog with data-testid='testimonial-modal'. VideoPlayer uses autoPlay=true in modal so iframe/<video> mounts immediately on open (no need to click testimonial-video-play). Escape does NOT close modal while Loom/Vimeo iframe has focus; use page.mouse.click on overlay coordinates (e.g., 20,20) to close between cards. MP4 served from Express static at /testimonials/prime-baths.mp4 (Content-Type: video/mp4, 7.35MB, supports range).
rca of the issue: No functional issues. Only a UX note: keyboard Escape close is blocked once focus enters the embedded video iframe; this is a known Radix + cross-origin iframe limitation.
